subject: SOC2 access + trust hub onboarding for MedCraft
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie@medcraft.ai>, Procurement <procure@medcraft.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:02:10 -0700
Subject: Intro + SOC 2 / trust hub access

Hi Natalie / MedCraft procurement team —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can keep things moving on the procurement side: 

- Redwood onboarding: we covered the architecture overview, dataflows (no PII persistence by default), and our options for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Security asks you flagged: SOC 2 Type II report, a signed bridge letter confirming continuous coverage during report transition, and access to our trust portal (we call it TrustHub) to pull supporting artifacts.
- Timing: sounds like your security team wants artifacts by EOD Wednesday to review before Thursday’s procurement sync.

Next steps (from our side):
1) We’ll upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF to TrustHub and share a bridge letter template.
2) I’ll attach our VSQ starter template (vendor security questionnaire) so your team can mark questions that need follow-up.
3) Stephanie will coordinate a short handoff call with our compliance team if they need deeper evidence (logs, retention policy excerpts).

Attachments: RWI-VSQ-template.xlsx (attached)

If that timeline still works for you, we’ll aim to have the TrustHub link + bridge letter by lunchtime tomorrow.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(jordan.blake@redwood.com)

---
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie@medcraft.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medcraft.ai>, Rob Stein <rob@cyberassure.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:18:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SOC 2 / trust hub access

Thanks Jordan — appreciated the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Our security reviewer (CC: Rob Stein from CyberAssure) will want the most recent SOC 2 Type II report along with a bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months.
- We also need a statement about GDPR data processing roles and confirmation whether Redwood will sign a BAA (HIPAA) — that depends on the use case but we should get the paperwork in parallel.
- Procurement would like a PO template and estimated MRR/commit numbers for committed capacity; I can loop in finance separately.

Can you confirm estimated delivery times for the report + bridge letter, and whether TrustHub access is view-only or supports artifact download? Rob — if there’s anything specific you want from Redwood up front, flag it and we’ll include in the intake checklist.

—Natalie
Natalie Gomez | Head of Procurement & Security Operations | MedCraft AI
(natalie@medcraft.ai)
(attachment: medcraft_requirements.pdf)

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie@medcraft.ai>, Procurement <procure@medcraft.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SOC 2 / trust hub access

Hi Natalie —

Great to meet you on the call. Quick answers to the questions above and what I just uploaded: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: I have uploaded a redacted copy of our 2025 SOC 2 Type II report to TrustHub. You can view and download evidence artifacts from the link below. Full unredacted copies are provided under an NDA; if your legal team needs that, we can coordinate via DocuSign.
   - Uploaded: SOC2-TypeII-2025-redacted.pdf (attachment)

2) Bridge letter: I’ve attached our bridge letter template — this is signed by our Head of Security and confirms coverage between report periods. I’ll route the signed copy via DocuSign once you confirm the contact for signature.
   - Attached: bridge_letter_template.pdf (I will send signed copy within 24 hours)

3) TrustHub access: link below — current permission is view + download for named MedCraft users. If you want programmatic access or an enterprise connector, we can route to our platform team.
   - TrustHub link: https://redwood.in/trusthub/medcraft-RWI-3742

4) GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood is a data processor for the hosted API model; we have DPAs available and can sign a BAA where the product is configured for PHI. I’ve included the DocuSign link for a BAA template if that’s needed.
   - DocuSign (BAA): https://app.docusign.com/secure/signon?token=abc123-docusign

4) Subprocessors / supply chain: Monica is copying a current subprocessor CSV and will upload it to the TrustHub in the next hour.
   - Will upload: subprocessor_list.csv

Let me know the two people from MedCraft who should get TrustHub access (full name + work email) and I’ll provision.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen | Director, Customer Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
(stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com)

---
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie@medcraft.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@medcraft.ai>, Rob Stein <rob@cyberassure.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SOC 2 / trust hub access

Thanks Stephanie — that looks great and should be sufficient for our initial review. We will: 

- Provision two reviewers to the TrustHub today (names below) and run a quick scan.
- Procurement will start a draft PO while security confirms whether they need the unredacted report under NDA.
- Rob, copying you — could you confirm whether the bridge letter template covers the continuous coverage language you require? If not, we’ll request the signed version and flag additional evidence.

Reviewers to add to TrustHub:
- Marcus Hill (marcus.hill@medcraft.ai)
- Priya Rao (priya.rao@medcraft.ai)

We may also ask for the completed VSQ (your template attached earlier) with a few clarifying answers about retention windows and log retention. If you could pre-fill expected retention values where possible that would speed review.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. I’ll report back once our security team has scanned the artifacts.

Best,
Natalie

---
